lines.en: I move slowly across the open ground.

lines.zh: 我的腿有点怪，走起来歪
lines.en: My legs walk crooked.
I drag myself forward.
I circle a pile of something.
My shadow is crooked.
I head toward the village.
I cross a stretch of grass.
I pause, then walk on.
My arms hang very low.
My gait rises and falls.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿往这边来
lines.en: I drag one leg along toward you.
I shift along the wall.
I step over an old shirt.

lines.zh: 我停下来，回头找刚才的路
lines.en: I stop and look back for the way I came.
I walk toward the light.
I inch forward.
I stand with my head cocked.
This place has not changed yet.
I do nothing but stand.
My mouth keeps moving.
I just stand here and watch the sky.
The wind carries my smell away.
I raise one hand slowly.
Something on me hurts.
I appeared very early.
I look at the sky with my neck bent.
My breathing is uneven.
There are still living ones here.
I stand still and only wait.
My fingers tremble.

lines.zh: 我想不起自己以前是什么
lines.en: I cannot recall what I was.
I listen to a call far off.
You do not look changed yet.

lines.zh: 我的脸从歪着的一边转过来
lines.en: I turn my face in from its crooked side.
You will be soon enough.
I came all this way.

lines.zh: 你身上还是干净的味道
lines.en: You still smell clean.
I mean to point at you; my hand drops.
Why are you not running?
I know your shape.

lines.zh: 我们眼睛差不多在一个高度
lines.en: Our eyes sit at nearly the same height.
I want a closer look.
Move, and I lean with you.
I smile with my neck bent.
I lurch sideways.
That one hurt badly.
My neck clicks.
I lurch half a pace back.

lines.zh: 我的皮裂开了，里面是黑的
lines.en: My skin split open, black underneath.
I catch hold of the wall.
My breathing turns rapid.
I look at the wound and say nothing.
These legs can still walk.
I am crooked, but standing.
That is of no use.

lines.zh: 你举那么高，是给我看的
lines.en: Held up that high - is it for me?
I am not really hungry.
It is something else I smell.
You keep this.
I shake my head, and my neck clicks.
I edge closer, little by little.
Is this thing alive?
I cannot get this down.
Do not pull your hand back yet.
This smells old.
I would like to try a bite.
It crumbles in my palm.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，想不起要做什么
lines.en: I stare at it, forgetting what to do.
Set it on the ground first.
I probably should not eat it.
You walk straight into me.
I sway, then steady.
Neither of us is steady.
I step half a pace aside.
Your foot is on mine.
I knock against your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的肩被撞得歪到一边
lines.en: The blow knocked my shoulder out of line.
I am keeping that bump in mind.
We pass by each other.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀顶到了我的肋
lines.en: Your shoulder found my ribs.
I came first; I have no mate.
I have not worked such things out.
I have always been alone.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，谈不上这些
lines.en: Looking like this, I don't get to have that.
I cock my head and do not answer.

lines.zh: 我转过半个身子，又停住
lines.en: I turn halfway round and stop.
I am the only one around here.
Nobody ever taught me that.
I walk slowly away.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都想不起
lines.en: I can't even recall my own name.
I pick it up and examine it.

lines.zh: 我捏着它，它在我手里陷下去
lines.en: I squeeze it and it sinks in my grip.
I squeeze and it flattens.
My pocket came apart long ago.
It slips out of my hand.
Whoever dropped this, it is mine.
I hold it backwards, then turn it right.
I toss it back.
I hold it a while and forget.
This is of no use at all.
You keep looking at me.
I turn my head slowly.
My eyes are on you now.
No need to walk; my arm reaches you.
I do not like being watched.
My fingers uncurl, far too long.
I shuffle half a step your way.
You were the one who struck first.
My fingers have stiffened.
I did not want this.
My feet drag across the floor.

lines.zh: 我的头一直歪着没正过来
lines.en: My head never straightens.
You step back, I step forward.
I am unsteady, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸一声重过一声
lines.en: My breathing grows heavier each time.

lines.zh: 我一边挪一边数你的动作
lines.en: I shuffle and count your movements.

lines.zh: 我那只手已经抬起来了
lines.en: That hand of mine is up.
From where you stand, I can reach you.

lines.zh: 我看着你的肩在慢慢转
lines.en: I watch your shoulder start to turn.
I shuffle a little nearer.
I swing my hand.

lines.zh: 我的手拍下去，软绵绵的
lines.en: My hand comes down, soft and useless.
You fell back two steps.
I catch your sleeve.
My nails rake you.
I swing once more.
I swing at nothing and nearly fall.
You blocked it.
My wrist bends wrong.
I pull back, breathing hard.
I come slowly out of the street corner.
A crooked shadow joins the street.
I was the first one out.
I cock my head and look at the street.
The ground is still whole.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看了看自己的手指
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at my fingers.

lines.zh: 我开始变的时候没人在
lines.en: No one was there when I started changing.
I walk forward step by step.
I push my upper half up off the ground.
My clothes still fit.
Fire burns my skin and it stings.
I fall down the steps.
Water fills my throat.
The blast pressed me flat to the wall.
An arrow buries in my shoulder.
Magic leaves me numb all over.
There's nothing left in my stomach.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我僵了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me and I freeze.
The ground beneath me is gone.
